headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.78
summary: The Logcat overlay now keeps working on Xiaomi devices: the new App-Level Logging option captures launcher and game logs in-process.

items.text: App-Level Logging sub-option for the Logcat overlay: captures launcher and game logs in-process, bypassing MIUI/HyperOS logcat restrictions.
